digest.component_or_area: CLI help discovery and command routing
propositions: Twenty-one visible pure-intercept routes lack committed help artifacts and fail under 'rebar help <command>' discovery.
Identity child parsers disable help actions, causing '--help' requests to reach top-level usage and exit with errors.
The help-backed predicate must uniformly apply 'not route.hidden and not route.retired' across all help-discovery and overview-generation sites.

Overview help must include every live visible route outside the exact exemption set (help, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe) with route-owned parser descriptions for reconcile, enrich, identity, and certs routes.
Nested intercept families (audit, config, identity, llm, prompt, criteria, workflow) must enable child-parser help without executing handler code or mounting ticket stores.

CLI reference generation must consume committed route-help artifacts instead of mechanical rendering, preserving multi-line usage contracts and normalizing metavar notation consistently across Python versions.
